Error.description: The /v1/* control lane's error envelope. Takoform v2 uses application/problem+json and TakoformV2Problem instead. The OpenAI-compatible /v1/ai/* lane answers that API's own error shape and is documented separately.

hostCode.description: This Host's own finer name for the refusal, when the closed portable code taxonomy cannot carry the distinction. The released provider decodes it alongside the portable code and never acts on it, so it refines a classification rather than replacing one. `cross_resource_precondition` marks a refusal whose truth is held by another resource, which this Host re-attempts rather than replays under the caller's idempotency key.

patch.description: Stop/prepaid accepts reference and onLimit only. Prepaid authorizes spending purchased credit without a new charge. On-demand requires explicit published terms and consent revisions, a user-chosen monthly cash cap, and a selected attached card. An optional SetupIntent is verified when supplied; an existing saved card needs no new setup. Exact retries return the original command response before current terms or card checks, while changed input or principal conflicts. Stop withdraws fresh-charge consent atomically with never-dispatched abandonment; a dispatched unknown effect remains reserved for original recovery. Postpaid remains unavailable. The authenticated payment principal is recorded server-side.

200.description: Committed original command response, including an exact replay

400.description: Invalid action, fields, reference, cap or consent revision

409.description: Unsupported mode, reference conflict or concurrent policy change

get.summary: Read explicit on-demand spending terms
get.description: Read-only terms for explicit cash consent. Positive eligible deficits round up once to a funding quantum and then to the published minimum; zero deficit never charges. The published maximum is a single-charge bound, not an automatic charge loop. The caller must choose a monthly cash cap within the published bounds. Funding credits have face value and any duration expiry starts at first verified funding. Reading terms creates no consent or payment.

200.description: Published terms and card setup disclosure revision

503.description: Financial terms or schema are unavailable

post.summary: Begin or resume the original card registration
post.description: Registers a card through hosted Checkout setup mode without buying credit or a plan. The server binds the original Organization, payment principal, reference, disclosure and customer. New commands must acknowledge the current setup disclosure; exact retries retain the original disclosure and command. Only this payments:write operation may return a transient Checkout action URL. After setup succeeds, replay it to obtain the paymentMethodId and setupIntentId for a separate explicit limit-policy consent. Setup success grants neither cash consent nor wallet credit. Unknown acknowledgements recover the original with reads; absence or session expiry never authorizes another create.

200.description: Original receipt, transient action or verified card selection

Receive one signed Stripe event. Served only where Stripe funding and a webhook signing secret are configured; the Stripe-Signature header over the raw body is the credential, and amounts are re-read from Stripe

200.description: Verified and recorded, including an already-settled redelivery

post.summary: Run the payment reconcile pass now, on the operator's single-use assertion
post.description: Runs the same pass as the scheduled reconcile and returns its report. Served only where Stripe funding is configured and an operator identity key is present. The credential is a `payments-reconcile` assertion signed by the operator identity key: it names this Host's public origin as `aud`, carries a `jti` nonce and exactly the claims `purpose`, `aud`, `jti`, `iat` and `exp`, lives at most sixty seconds and is spent before the pass runs. No session or API key can run it. A repeat credits nothing twice, because every path credits through the same `stripe:<session id>` funding reference. On a Bun Host a request arriving while a pass is running joins that pass; a Worker runs one pass per request.

401.description: Missing, expired, replayed, wrongly signed, wrong-purpose or wrong-audience operator assertion

404.description: Payment reconcile or an operator identity key is not configured

500.description: Internal failure, for example the assertion could not be recorded as spent; the pass did not run

503.description: Stripe could not be read; retryable with a fresh assertion, because this one is spent

post.summary: Begin monthly subscription Checkout in the configured Stripe realm using a plan key
post.description: Host sets Stripe Price, Organization/customer binding, tariff revision and return URLs. This operation grants no credit. Replay the same reference. Custody returns open/pending/associated/expired receipts; pending is 202 and retains the original command in every deployment mode. Commercial Hosted composition additionally requires its qualified financial adapter.

202.description: Checkout outcome pending; retry this reference without another payment

patch.summary: Schedule exclusive next-period plan change or subscription cancellation
patch.description: Cancellation requires cancelAtPeriodEnd=true and expectedSubscriptionRef from GET in every deployment mode, and returns a durable cancellation receipt. A qualified plan action instead requires planKey and the same expected target; it schedules next-period terms without proration or an immediate charge/grant. Actions are mutually exclusive. Missing plan qualification is refused. Pending outcomes retain their reference and recover by readback rather than another Stripe POST.

200.description: Verified cancellation receipt for the expected target

202.description: Original cancellation or plan command remains pending

409.description: Expected subscription changed or reference conflicts

get.summary: Read one saved subscription command descriptor

Reads the saved original command and its local workflow proof without resuming it, registering pricing, refreshing native objects or writing financial state. Start lifecycle and scheduled cancellation do not prove the target ended. A missing command is not proof of no effect or completed reconciliation. No query parameters are accepted. Source epoch and payer authority are qualified separately.

404.description: Qualified receipt capability or stored command absent; no terminal proof
